title: 第3章 天性纯良李幼薇第4章 仙人所授太极剑
content_zh:
;;
第一关过了，如此轻率，如此耐人寻味。
李子夜不会承认他送了礼。
秦婀娜也不会承认，她因为收了礼才放水。
日落时，秦婀娜走了，临走前，说出第二个考验。
一日内，创出一套剑法。
“送分题。”
李子夜听过之后，只说了三个字。
连渝州城的百姓都在传，他十岁便自创了一套剑法，名为太极，这一题，就是送分。
老秦为了放水，也是煞费苦心。
“儿子，有把握？”
李百万看到自己儿子云淡风轻的样子，兴奋道。
“十拿九稳。”
李子夜随意挥了挥手，旋即去后院准备继续钓鱼。
“过了？”
后院，湖边，张邋遢依旧还在老神在在地闭目养神，感知到李子夜到来，问道。
“过了。”
李子夜点头道。
“就凭你那柄金子铸的破剑？”
这次，反倒是张邋遢惊讶了，双眸睁开，问道。

“当然，不可能。”
李子夜皮笑肉不笑道，“昨天，幼微姐给老秦送去了一颗东海夜明珠，一件天蚕软甲，还有那柄鱼肠剑，我家老李这次是下血本了。”
“鱼肠剑？”
张邋遢一下坐了起来，大吃一惊道，“鱼肠剑原来在李府之中？”
“不然呢。”
李子夜捡起一块石子扔入湖水中，道，“若不拿出点看家宝，老秦又怎么会放水。”
“佩服，佩服。”
张邋遢这次真的服气了，感慨道，“果然，有钱能使鬼推磨，秦婀娜，多么超凡脱俗的人物，竟然也不能免俗。”
“都是人，何必装纯。”
李子夜微笑道，“老秦确实非是寻常人，所以，我们给出的价钱也非比寻常。”
“那第二个考验呢，是什么？”张邋遢好奇道。
“一天内，创出一套剑法。”李子夜说道。
“……”
张邋遢无语，刚才或许还有几分怀疑，不过，现在他能肯定秦婀娜是在放水了。
“不明白啊，不明白。”
张邋遢看着眼前波光粼粼的湖面，道，“那秦婀娜一向爱惜名声，就不怕最后收个纨绔子弟为徒，一世英名尽毁吗？”
“她当然怕，不然为何她走了半个大商朝，还没有做决定？”
李子夜轻声一笑，道，“我费那么大力气让人造谣，可不是钱多烧的。”
“那又如何？”
张邋遢皱眉道，“秦婀娜不会只凭谣言便相信你便是传说中的绝世奇才。”

“她来了，便是信了，至少，信了一部分。”
李子夜嘴角露出一抹奇异的微笑，道，“老张你不懂，这叫心理暗示，为什么历代皇朝那么多昏君，他们就真的辩不了是非吗，当然不是，有奸臣的谗言，有宠妃的枕边风，很多时候，不信，也信了。”
content_en:
;;
Passed the first level, so flippant, so thought-provoking.
Li Ziye would not admit that he gave the gift.
Qin Wegna would not admit that she let it go because she accepted the gift.
At sunset, Qin Grace left. Before leaving, she told her the second test.
In one day, he created a set of sword techniques.
"Send points."
After Li Ziye heard this, he only said three words.
Even the people in Yuzhou City are spreading the word that he created his own sword technique at the age of ten, called Tai Chi. This question is for giving points.
Lao Qin also took great pains to release the water.
"Son, are you sure?"
Li Baiwan said excitedly when he saw his son's calm appearance.
"Nine times out of ten."
Li Ziye waved his hand casually and immediately went to the backyard to continue fishing.
"Passed?"
In the backyard, by the lake, Zhang Sloppy was still there, closing his eyes and concentrating. He sensed Li Ziye's arrival and asked.
"Passed."
Li Ziye nodded.
"Only because of your broken sword made of gold?"
This time, Zhang Sloppy was surprised. He opened his eyes and asked.
"Of course, impossible."
Li Ziye smiled and said, "Yesterday, Sister Youwei gave Lao Qin an East China Sea night pearl, a piece of silkworm soft armor, and the fish intestine sword. My Lao Li has spent a lot of money this time."
"Fish Gut Sword?"
Zhang Sloppy sat up and said in surprise, "The Fish Intestine Sword is in the Li Mansion?"
"Otherwise."
Li Ziye picked up a stone and threw it into the lake, saying, "If you don't take out some treasures to look at, how could Lao Qin let it go?"
"I admire you, I admire you."
Zhang Sultan was really convinced this time and said with emotion, "Sure enough, money can make the world go round. Qin Grace, such an extraordinary person, is not immune to the world."
"We are all human beings, why bother pretending to be innocent."
Li Ziye smiled and said, "Old Qin is indeed an extraordinary person, so the price we offered is also extraordinary."
"What about the second test?" Zhang Slutty asked curiously.
"Create a set of sword techniques in one day." Li Ziye said.
"..."
Zhang Sloppy was speechless. He might have been a little suspicious just now, but now he was sure that Qin Grace was letting him go.
"I don't understand, I don't understand."
Zhang Slutty looked at the sparkling lake in front of him and said, "Then Qin Wanna has always cherished her reputation, isn't she afraid that in the end she will accept a dandy as her disciple, and her reputation will be ruined for the rest of her life?"
"Of course she is afraid, otherwise why would she have left half of the Shang Dynasty and not made a decision yet?"
Li Ziye smiled softly and said, "The reason why I put so much effort into spreading rumors is not just for the money."
"So what?"
Zhang Slutty frowned and said, "Qin Grace will not believe that you are the legendary genius just based on rumors."
"When she came, she believed it, at least partly."
A strange smile appeared on the corner of Li Ziye's mouth, and he said, "Old Zhang, you don't understand. This is called psychological suggestion. Why are there so many foolish kings in the past dynasties, and they really can't tell right from wrong? Of course not. There are slanderous words from treacherous officials, and pillow talk from beloved concubines. Many times, even if you don't believe it, you will believe it."
